room.landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.landing.description: Bram steadies the ferry with his boot. Across the water, a lantern swings once between the reeds and goes dark. "Mine is up at the shelter," he says. "Bring it down. Then tell me whether you are coming with us." An old gate stands in the west fence.
room.landing.player_led: The ferry rocks at its rope. The search party will wait on Bram; the reeds along the bank wait for your light. An old gate stands in the west fence.
room.landing.party_led: The ferry rocks at its rope. The search party will go out with Bram and the lantern; the bank is theirs tonight. An old gate stands in the west fence.
room.green.title: Village Green
room.green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass. A path runs east toward the reeds.
room.reed_bank.title: Reed Bank
room.reed_bank.description: Tall reeds hiss in the wind. The path is soft underfoot and runs on east to a small shelter.
room.shelter.title: Lantern Shelter
room.shelter.description: A lean-to of tarred planks keeps the rain off a bench and a hook. An old gate in the east fence opens onto the landing.
npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry. He keeps the landing by day and goes up to the green at dusk.
item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] is here, a small iron key on its ring.
item.lantern.description: Dented brass, still smelling of oil. A small iron key hangs from its ring.
quest.lantern.title: Bram's lantern
dialogue.bram.prompt: Bram looks at the lantern, then at the reeds. "Are you coming with us, or do you mean to go along the bank yourself?"
dialogue.bram.leave: Leave it with the search party
proof.carry: You keep the lantern. Bram nods once and points you down the bank.
proof.leave: You hand Bram the lantern. He lifts it toward the reeds and calls the others in.
